description: Republish an earlier version of a program's intake definition as a NEW version (history is never edited). Same impact rule as editing: dryRun first, acknowledgeImpact to proceed.

acknowledgeImpact.description: Proceed although the change removes or changes items open requests hold answers for. Set it only after reviewing the impact a first attempt returned.

dryRun.description: Return what the change would do to open drafts and write nothing.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

ifRevision.description: The `revision` you read; the change is refused if the program moved since.

reason.description: Why, kept on the version and in the audit event (300 characters at most).

name: anyforge_restore_program_intake_version
title: Restore program intake version
